title: 1985 AMC 8 Problem 13
statement: If you walk for \(45\) minutes at a rate of \(4\) mph and then run for \(30\) minutes at a rate of \(10\) mph, how many miles have you gone at the end of one hour and \(15\) minutes?

solutions.text:
Walking: \(4 \times \dfrac34 = 3\) miles. Running: \(10 \times \dfrac12 = 5\) miles.

The total distance is \(3 + 5 = 8\) miles.

Thus, the correct answer is B .
hints: Convert each time to hours: \(45\) minutes \(= \dfrac34\) hour and \(30\) minutes \(= \dfrac12\) hour
Distance \(=\) rate \(\times\) time for each part, then add the two distances
